newsitem.title: USA: Compaq says introduces new systems.
newsitem.headline: Compaq says introduces new systems.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Monday it introduced new uninterruptible power supply products targeted at entry-level and mid-range servers and workstations.
Compaq said it has added two new models to its UPS product line, the Compaq Tower 700 VA UPS and Rack Mountable 1500 VA UPS.
Both new Compaq UPS models ship with Compaq Power Management Software. The software can be customized to perform diagnostic checks and prioritized shutdowns.
In addition, Compaq said it has introduced two UPS option cards, the Compaq Multi-Server UPS Card and the Compaq Scalable UPS Card.
The multi-server UPS Card allows a single Compaq UPS to support and communicate directly with up to three servers, eliminating the need to purchase a separate UPS to support each server.
Compaq also introduced the new Compaq Power Distribution Unit, which consolidates the number of power cords needed.
All Compaq enterprise option products are available immediately in volume.
The 700 VA UPS is priced at $380, the 1500 VA UPS is priced at $1,045, the UPS Card is priced at $150, the Scalable UPS Card is priced at $150 and the Power Distribution Unit is priced at $325.
Compaq also said it is offering, on a worldwide basis, an entry-level server with Intel Corp's new Pentium II processor targeting small and medium-sized businesses.
Compaq said the new model of the ProSignia 200 server features the processor. It expects the system to reduce acquisition, installation and ownership costs.
Compaq will offer the new Pentium II 233 MHz model with prices starting at $2,417.
